title: A lifting partition theorem for tropical tritangent classes to smooth space sextic curves
summary: The set of tritangent planes to smooth tropical space sextic curves has 15 connected components, recording continuous displacements of planes preserving the tritangency condition. These 15 tritangent classes are polyhedral complexes in $\mathbf{R}^3$, and each of them contains the tropicalization of precisely eight tritangent planes to any smooth space sextic curve with the given tropicalization.
